rules.statement: The court should allow evidence of moneys paid by the defendant for a purchase to show the date from which adverse possession began, but not to establish title.
rules.supporting_quote: "A. J.-The general purport of the decisions as to what exceptions can be allowed or not to the strict observance of our Statute of Frauds may be summarized as follows: - (1) When an agreement, being verbal, cannot be enforced, moneys paid thereon for the ulterior objects of the agreement may be recovered..."
